prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a big armoured rust-brown centipede seen from the side, a compact body of about eight overlapping shiny plates (the whole centipede, tail end included, well inside its own cell with empty space on both sides), many short jointed legs on the ground, the front third raised up low with a plated head, two huge curved mandibles and a drop of green venom at their tips (attached), small black eyes; in every cell the raised front stays well below the top of the box. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its plated head with small black eyes and huge mandibles is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging the head forward and down toward the heroes with the mandibles spread wide, the front a little lower than in the idle cell (no taller than its idle height); the head and the mandible tips end well before the right edge of the middle cell (not reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, still facing right with the head and mandibles toward the heroes on the right and the tail on the left as in the idle cell, the head pulled down and back, the mandibles clenched, the legs scrabbling; no taller than its idle height (no rearing up, never turned around), recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Lower or raise the body along a strong diagonal, extend the fangs, pincers or stinger far toward the heroes, and splay the legs while their tips stay on the ground line. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, seen from the side, legs spread, every leg tip on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, wings, a stinger tail, pincers, soft pale skin, a rear-up taller than the box.
